turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. You can request cancellation as soon as possible, as long as your order has not entered warehouse preparation.

Once preparation has started or the order has shipped, direct cancellation is no longer possible. In that case, you’ll need to refuse the parcel on delivery so it returns to the warehouse and the refund process can begin.

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail: No. An order that has already been placed cannot be modified to add an item. The original order must be cancelled and refunded first, then you can place a new order with the additional item.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
No. Once the order has shipped, it can’t be changed to add or replace an item. You can place a separate order for the additional item.

If you need to cancel the shipped order, refuse the parcel on delivery. It will be returned to the warehouse and the refund process will begin.

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
If your cancellation is approved before warehouse preparation starts, the refund process begins once the cancellation is confirmed. We do not have a confirmed timeframe for the refund itself, so I don’t want to promise a specific number of days.

If the order has already entered preparation or shipped, you must refuse the parcel on delivery. Its return to the warehouse will start the refund process.

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail: No. Once validated, separate orders can’t be merged into one shipment. Each order is processed and shipped independently.
